the Philippines was a major industrial success story from 1870 until the 1980's, when it was hit by a 'perfect industrializing storm' of negative forces.
Philippine industrial growth was strong for seven decades, but it was not strong enough to overcome the negative forces of the 1980 de industrialization shock.
